notes.title: Halloween Update!!!
notes.notes:
Hello frolfers, and welcome to the first content update for ultimate frolf chaos!

This update includes a new course, the Pumpkin Patch, and with it a few new spooky obstacles on both
the Pumpkin Patch course and Monsterville, so be sure to check those out!

Other changes:


 Multiplayer fixes
 Player markers now show where other players are on the map
 Mouse scroll wheel can now be used to zoom in and out

As a bonus, here is the concept art for the map :)
Happy Frolfing!
